owner_decision: 19/11: stop pulse-live-v7-1119 (stopped 18/11 19:28 UTC before any attack, data deleted) and try every open direction until none improves further; then one live run with every adopted change
registered_before: any code or computation of the directions below
rule: each direction is adopted only when it meets its criterion; adopted changes that touch the scoring are rerun on LID-DS 2021 official and reported beside the base; nothing is adopted on the live run itself

D1_gram_map_overflow.what: the worker turns an increase of the loader insert_fail counter into an alert on the window with the most distinct grams of that frame (the cgroup filling the map) and flags the frame incomplete
D1_gram_map_overflow.criterion: under gram_stress at 400,000 calls/s (map-capacity-v1) an alert on the stress cgroup within 1 s of the first failure; 0 such alerts on pulse-token-capture-v6-1116 and the v6 live run (insert_fail 0 there)

D2_loader_window_end.what: window_end from PULSE_TOK_WINDOW_NS instead of the literal 0.5

D3_durable_bridge_queue.what: undelivered alert episodes kept on disk and retried with backoff instead of three tries
D3_durable_bridge_queue.criterion: unit test with a fake Alertmanager that refuses then accepts: every episode delivered once, in order; no fault test on the cluster (owner rule)

D4_ensemble_top3_top10.what: alarm when top-3 OR top-10 exceeds its threshold, alpha split between them
D4_ensemble_top3_top10.criterion: LID-DS 2021 development >= 529/544 with <= 6 false alarms and CB-DS >= 891, <= 3, and more 2019 development detections than lidds-ml-v5-t3 (310/321)

D5_session_stream.what: (a) two-channel alert path from the lineage tag, offline on pulse-live-v6-1117; (b) a session model learnt from the session windows of all workloads (kubelet exec probes, operator sessions) with empirical and Gumbel thresholds
D5_session_stream.criterion: (b) session channel flags >= 95 % of exec attacks and <= 20 % of unseen operator commands and harmless binaries; otherwise reported as a limit

D6_five_syscall_probe.what: probe build that hooks only open/openat, read, recv/recvfrom, stat and write (token-design-study q1 smallest subset) for lower overhead
D6_five_syscall_probe.criterion: proof passes; overhead A/B lower than the 39-syscall build on every operation; LID-DS 2021 official of the subset with the t3 configuration >= 95 % recall, <= 1 % false alarms

D7_request_overhead.what: latency of real HTTP requests to a production service with the probe loaded and unloaded, rotated rounds

D8_richer_tokens.what: alphabet variants with more detail (full path hash, connect address family and port class) on LID-DS 2021 development, including the seen-only simulation of token-design-study q4
D8_richer_tokens.criterion: more seen-only detections than select1f while keeping LID-DS 2021 development >= 529/544, <= 6 and CB-DS

D9_refit_policy.what: how fast the held-out exceedance grows with model age on the captures (v5 model on v6 capture already measured)
